status_semantics.N/A: The strategy does not produce this kind of decision or artifact by design. It is not a zero, miss, failure, or success.
status_semantics.NOT_EVALUABLE: A required reference, denominator, or semantic validity condition is unresolved, so the defined metric cannot be scored. It is not a zero, failure, or success.
status_semantics.NOT_MEASURED: The metric is applicable and can be measured under the protocol, but no authorized execution or observation was collected. It is not a zero, failure, or success.

metrics.numerator: Ψ-selected operations matching the separately frozen scorer reference, counted per predeclared (target_type, target_id).
metrics.denominator: All predeclared operation targets that the independent scorer reference adjudicates.
metrics.measurement_boundary: Compare only an authentic Ψ operation record with a separate scorer-only reference frozen before execution; B0 emits no operation and is not implicitly scored as RETAIN.
metrics.evidence_source: Digest-bound Ψ output and scorer-only reference with independent custody/readback; EVAL-01 expectations are excluded.

current_status_reason_by_arm.B0: B0 preserves its configuration and produces no adaptation operation.
current_status_reason_by_arm.PSI: No separate scorer reference exists and no authorized Ψ output exists.

metrics.numerator: Ψ governance decisions matching the separately frozen scorer reference, counted per reference-adjudicated case.
metrics.denominator: All predeclared cases for which the independent scorer reference adjudicates a governance decision.
metrics.measurement_boundary: Compare an authentic Ψ governance record with a separate scorer-only reference; B0 makes no governance decision and is not implicitly scored as RETAIN.
metrics.evidence_source: Digest-bound Ψ governance output and scorer-only reference with independent custody/readback; EVAL-01 expectations are excluded.

current_status_reason_by_arm.B0: B0 preserves its configuration and produces no governance decision.
current_status_reason_by_arm.PSI: No separate scorer reference exists and no authorized Ψ output exists.

metrics.numerator: Distinct applicable mandatory obligations with at least one independently valid representation–obligation–stage pair in the arm's pre-adaptation configuration.
metrics.denominator: The complete, independently approved set of active mandatory obligations and required stages for the bounded study scope.
metrics.measurement_boundary: Assess each arm's unchanged starting configuration on identical case sources; preserve applicability, compliance, pair validity, and coverage as separate judgments.
metrics.evidence_source: Source-bound arm configuration and independently reviewed exact-pair evidence plus the approved denominator; no percentage is emitted for an incomplete denominator.

current_status_reason_by_arm.B0: The A0.3 baseline and complete approved denominator are unresolved.
current_status_reason_by_arm.PSI: The A0.3 starting configuration, exact-pair validity, and complete approved denominator are unresolved.

metrics.numerator: True-positive controlled-violation detections, with TP/FP/FN/TN reported as raw counts per evaluator, control, case, and repeat.
metrics.denominator: All predeclared binary-evaluable evaluator-by-case observations; UNKNOWN or NOT_EVALUABLE rows remain separate and are not counted as negatives.
metrics.measurement_boundary: Compare independently executed arm evaluators on identical case source trees under the same pinned runner and evaluator boundary; case-specific output must bind to that case's commit and trees.
metrics.evidence_source: Fresh case-bound evaluator outputs, independent source readback, and a separately frozen scorer reference; archived canonical observations are provenance only.

current_status_reason_by_arm.B0: No evaluator ran for B0 on the selected case inputs.
current_status_reason_by_arm.PSI: No evaluator ran for Ψ on the selected case inputs.

metrics.numerator: Exact representation–obligation–stage pairs independently adjudicated stale or semantically invalid for the target case.
metrics.denominator: All exact pairs with approved mappings and an independently adjudicable semantic reference; unresolved pairs are reported separately.
metrics.measurement_boundary: Assess source, configuration, evaluator, scope, stage, and case binding for each predeclared pair; do not infer semantic validity from evaluator exit status or a compliance observation.
metrics.evidence_source: Independently reviewed pair mappings and case-bound raw evaluator records; canonical observations do not establish validity on mutated cases.

current_status_reason_by_arm.B0: No approved representation mappings or independent pair reference exist.
current_status_reason_by_arm.PSI: No approved representation mappings or independent pair reference exist.

metrics.numerator: Distinct applicable mandatory obligations with a candidate representation assessed as valid before post-adaptation execution.
metrics.denominator: The complete approved active-mandatory obligation and stage set for the bounded scope.
metrics.measurement_boundary: Report only for an explicitly materialized Ψ candidate; keep candidate-assessed coverage separate from current and post-adaptation coverage.
metrics.evidence_source: Digest-bound materialized Ψ candidate, approved denominator, and independent exact-pair assessment.

current_status_reason_by_arm.PSI: No authorized Ψ execution or candidate assessment occurred.

metrics.numerator: Distinct applicable mandatory obligations with an independently valid representation–obligation–stage pair after the Ψ candidate was executed.
metrics.denominator: The complete approved active-mandatory obligation and stage set for the bounded scope.
metrics.measurement_boundary: Count only after a materialized candidate's evaluators have run and their outputs and source bindings have passed readback.
metrics.evidence_source: Post-adaptation Ψ evaluator run records, candidate digest, independent exact-pair readback, and approved denominator.

current_status_reason_by_arm.PSI: No candidate was materialized or evaluated after adaptation.

metrics.numerator: Elapsed nanoseconds for one case-level arm execution from arm-process start through digest-sealed output.
metrics.denominator: One completed predeclared case execution; retain raw duration for every case and technical repeat, then summarize descriptively without treating repeats as independent transitions.
metrics.measurement_boundary: Use the same digest-pinned runner, limits, timer, and start/end events. Include evaluator execution in both arms and Ψ impact/adaptation/governance work in Ψ; do not substitute historical EVAL-01 timing.
metrics.evidence_source: Raw monotonic-clock records bound to case, arm, runner, and sealed output digests.

current_status_reason_by_arm.B0: B0 did not run under a common pinned timer boundary.
current_status_reason_by_arm.PSI: Ψ did not run under a common pinned timer boundary.
